decode.scroll_stop_trick: A blunt three-line question in black condensed caps ('CAN'T STAY HARD? LOOK AT YOUR BLOOD FLOW.') over two cut-open arteries, one clogged, one clear, with the jar standing between them as the switch.
decode.angle_carried: mechanism reveal: your problem is a flow problem
decode.hidden_reading: the leet 'ER3CT!ONS' (policy dodge) — ours needs none, nothing to dodge
decode.scene_logic: no scene; a diagram on cream paper. Ours: the same diagram, the vessel that drains the leg instead of an artery, because her problem is fluid that stopped moving
decode.visual_trick: two diagonal cut-open tubes mirrored left/right, left narrowed and clogged with yellow sludge and a small arrow, right wide and clear with a big arrow; callout lines with small labels — copy literally
decode.shape_or_function_equivalent: clogged artery tube ↔ a blocked drainage vessel in the calf: left the tube is squeezed by swollen, pale, water-logged tissue around it and the fluid inside is stagnant yellowish; right the tube is open, tissue calm and pink, fluid moving (arrow)
decode.structure_type: split (blocked vs clear) with a centred product
decode.render_style: coloured-pencil / crayon medical sketch on cream #f5e9d8, hand-drawn hatching, thin black callout lines
decode.text_treatment: heavy condensed black caps (Anton-like) for headline and footer, bold caps panel labels, small regular callouts; product centred bottom with a long thin vertical line down to it

strategy.angle: A8-L heavy, swollen legs — look at what's holding the fluid
strategy.mechanism: M1: when the body can't clear everyday oxidative stress, the tissue in the legs stays inflamed and stops draining normally, so fluid sits there — heavy, tender, puffy — and no diet reaches it, because it was never fat; the tablet turns a glass of water into hydrogen-rich water, hydrogen is the smallest molecule there is, reaches the tissue and helps the body switch that process off so normal drainage can resume
strategy.sub_avatar: trigger: swollen by evening every day, told it's weight · cause: inflamed tissue blocking the drainage · tried: diets, water tablets
strategy.belief_installed: It was never fat. It's fluid my body stopped clearing — and no diet reaches it.
